text:
marta: Quick sync — starting hera-22b onboarding. Weights are in s3://redwood-models/hera/22b/v1/weights. Config at s3://redwood-models/hera/22b/v1/config.json.

zack: on it. I can run the baseline smoke tests. Any failing test seeds you already saw?

marta: saw tokenizer splitting BOS for a few prompts (short prompts only). Also when seq_len > 4096, final tokens look like attention collapse — possibly RoPE scale mismatch or MQA bucket misalignment. Not blocking but want a quick triage.

alice: re: tokenizer — can you paste a concrete example? our tokenizers sometimes normalize unicode NFKC by default.

marta: example input: "\\u200bHello" (zero-width space). Tokenized to: [50256, 146, ...] but expected BOS+Hello. Patch attached shows tokenizer.json uses byte fallback. 

ben: for RoPE scaling, check `rotary_scaling` in config.json — older models used `rotary_scaling: { base: 512 }` vs new `rotary_scaling: { alpha: 1.0 }`. If mismatched we see position drift around 4k.

chloe: I ran a quick generation with kv-prefetch enabled. Logs:
```
INFO runtime: model hera-22b v1 starting
WARN tokenizer: replaced unknown bytes with <unk>
ERROR attention: kv cache mismatch at layer 9, expected 0x03 got 0x00
```
Looks like a weight/packer mismatch in attention kernel.

marta: thanks. I also noticed MQA flags in the model meta: "grouped_qkv": true. Could explain kernel selection differences.

zack: plan — (1) verify weights checksum (marta please reupload if different), (2) run tokenizer smoke using tokenizer-cli against tokenizer.json and a few edge cases (zero-width, fullwidth spaces), (3) run an attention-impl smoke with `--trace-layer=9` to capture mismatch, (4) if kernel mismatch, fallback to legacy attention path and notify infra.

marta: reuploaded weights with sha256 `f7c8...a12`. Pinged infra for ephemeral instance.

alice: I've opened a tiny PR to tolerate zero-width in tokenizer normalizer: #4380 — @marta can you add a failing case to tests/tokenizer/edgecases.json?

marta: done.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: staging-hera-22b-smoke -> infra/ephemeral-3 (by zack). ETA 6m.

ben: if attention kernel fails we'll fallback to per-head non-optimized kernel; cost regressed but keeps correctness. I'll add a config flag `serve.force_legacy_attention=true` in the canary if needed.

chloe: FYI I validated MQA grouping offsets with the weights manifest; offsets look consistent. The KV cache mismatch still points to a packing detail. Suggest weight loader alignment check.

zack: PRs: ben (legacy flag) + alice (tokenizer fix). I'll run the attention trace and post logs here.

marta: thanks everyone. @zack please drop the smoke logs and final verdict. If green, I'll kick the onboard checklist to product.

zack: starting run now — will update in ~10m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

(10m later)

zack: smoke run finished. Results:
- tokenizer edgecases: pass (0 failures)
- attention trace: mismatch resolved after setting `force_legacy_attention=true` (we saw same error when optimized path active)
- generation sanity: pass on 1k and 8k contexts

zack: next steps — keep legacy attention for the canary, open infra ticket to reconcile packed-qkv layout (assigned to @infra-team). I'll file follow-up issue with traces and diffs.

marta: perfect. moving to canary. Thanks all :rocket:
